prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 96-120 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a bigger carnivorous plant monster of purple-black flesh: two round bulbs side by side on one thick stalk, each with its own wide toothy maw, sitting on a heavy dark root mass that rests on the ground, exactly four thick heavy purple vine tentacles as thick as an arm, each one solid and joined to the stalk, with short sharp thorns along them, swollen sickly yellow-green poison sacs on the stalk; in every cell the whole plant stays well inside its own cell. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: no eyes; the two toothy maws are the readable feature.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, the bulbs lunging forward with both maws gaping wide, the two front thorned vines reaching toward the heroes and curling into hooks in front of the bulbs at the height of the stalk, the root mass in place, exactly four vines and two maws as in the idle cell; every vine stays below the bulbs and curls back well before the right edge of the middle cell (no vine raised above the bulbs, none reaching the cell edge), facing right.
- right cell: hurt, both bulbs recoiling back, the maws snapped shut, the thorned vines curling in, the root mass in place, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Keep the base in place and whip the tentacles or vines far from the body along strong curves, the lead ones toward the heroes, the others swaying behind. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, coiled upright inside the box, the lowest coil resting on the ground line; the rooted base never leaves the ground. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, eyes, a face, legs, a pot, green colour, a third maw, a fifth vine, a pink flower, thin vines, loose thorns.
